meetings.title: 3rd Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: The draft committee report on the special audit report of the Police Housing Project (Blues Housing Project) was reviewed at today's meeting. The members discussed the sections to be included in the draft report and the information that needed to be clarified. It was also decided to meet with the Minister of Homeland Security and Technology, the Attorney General and the Prosecutor General to discuss the Committee’s observations on the matter and its recommendations, prior to finalizing the Committee Report.

meetings.title: 2nd Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: The special audit report of the Police Housing Project (Blues Housing Project) was reviewed at today's meeting. After discussing the documents received by the Committee, it was decided to seek further information from the relevant authorities.

meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: The appointment of the Committee chair and Deputy chair of the committee was scheduled for today’s meeting. Director General Shabana Rasheed presided over the election process of committee's chairperson and vice chairperson. Funadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Mamdhooh proposed to elect Dhiggaru Constituency Member Ahmed Nazim as the Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Eydhafushi Constituency Member Ahmed Saleem and passed unanimously. Funadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Mamdhooh proposed to elect Eydhafushi Constituency Member Ahmed Saleem as the Vice Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Eydhafushi Constituency Member Ahmed Saleem and passed unanimously. In addition, the committee discussed how to proceed with the review of the Audit Report. The committee decided to obtain further information from Ministry of Economic Development and Trade, Ministry of Tourism and Environment and Maldives Police Service. Also, it was decided to summon Attorney General and Prosecutor General to the next committee meeting.
